# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 7

This update brings a general graphics correctness improvement and experimental picture-in-picture support for external media apps.

## Graphics correction

- Fixed the horizontally divided image and missing lower portion observed in the opening real-time cutscene of **Kingdoms of Amalur: Reckoning**.
- This is a general core correction, applied automatically without additional settings. It may benefit other games affected by similar rendering problems, but wider game and GPU coverage still needs testing.
- Verified through repeated starts and progression to character creation on Odin 2. This does not certify the full campaign or promise a general FPS increase.

## Experimental picture-in-picture

- Keep the game full screen while a compatible external media app uses Android's floating video window.
- Added an app selector with PiP compatibility indicators, an optional media link, and controls in the game menu. Find these options under **Settings → App → Appearance and startup**.
- Direct opening requires Android 13 or later and a compatible app entry point. For apps that manage their own video PiP, use **Open video app**, start playback, activate that app's PiP, then return to the game. The game stays paused while another app is full screen.
- Picture-in-picture and automatic opening are both **disabled by default**.
- Enabling this mode mutes game audio. **Use game audio** restores it for the current session without changing your saved volume.

### PiP limitations and testing

Compatibility indicators describe app declarations and launch requirements; they do not certify video playback. Permissions, app restrictions and subscriptions still apply.

Android and the media app control window position, available sizes and playback controls. Closing from the game menu is best effort; some apps may require Android's close button. The emulator cannot force every installed app into a floating window.

Initial interface and lifecycle checks were completed on Odin 2. Real media playback, YouTube, incoming calls, TV mode and other devices still need testing and feedback. Running another app alongside the game also shares the device's resources; no performance benefit is claimed.

TV mode and synced player profiles also remain experimental.

Install over your current version; no uninstall is required. Keep a backup of your profiles and saves as usual.
